prompt_en: Create a photorealistic full-body occupational photograph of one unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties, an alpine seed-bank technician in a bioluminescent mountain greenhouse at blue hour. Her facial appearance follows the attached reference. Image 1 supplies facial appearance only: preserve its adult age impression, eye aperture shape and spacing, face length, lower-face and jaw width, nose, lips, cheekbones, skin tone, hairline, and natural asymmetry; her body geometry is independently authored here. Give her a distinctly slender build and a slender linear adult build: an adult head-to-feet body read with torso and both limbs remaining comparable at one scale; a long, narrow overall silhouette, a lightly built torso, lean arms and legs, slim upper arms and thighs; consistently narrow transverse torso volume with restrained ribcage waist and pelvic breadth; slender arm and leg volumes with coherent joint transitions; height muscle bust and hips declared separately from the slender body-build relation. She is fully clothed in a smooth matte unpadded non-cinching teal insulated coverall, thermal layer, gloves, utility belt, and boots. In a restrained three-quarter stance, she presses one labeled alpine seed capsule into an open cryogenic storage rack with her right gloved hand while her left steadies a scanner aimed at the capsule. Use a neutral eye-height 50 mm perspective with head and boots fully inside frame and both body contours clear. Cold glass, condensation, blue-green moss cultures, abstract color-coded seed drawers, amber task lamps, and snowy peaks form one coherent environment; realistic skin, fabric, frost, glass, hands, and anatomy.
